Evaluate expertise in Business Intelligence (BI), Business Objects, and SAP GRC. Candidates will be tested on their ability to deploy, manage, and optimize solutions.

About the SAP Security Consultant Assessment
The purpose of this assessment is to measure candidates for the SAP Security Consultant role, focusing on expertise in Business Intelligence (BI), BusinessObjects, and SAP GRC. Candidates will be tested on their ability to deploy, manage, and optimize solutions.
